rule.description: CI 中的 issue labeler 配置应覆盖仓库中使用的所有类型前缀（包括 `[Misc]`），确保所有 issue 都能被正确分类。

antipattern.code:
name: Bot Issue Manage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  issue-labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: github/issue-labeler@v3.4
        with:
          configuration-path: .github/issue-labeler.yml
          enable_title_based_labeling: true
          title-labels:
            - prefix: "[Bug]"
              labels: ["bug"]
            - prefix: "[Usage]"
              labels: ["usage"]
            - prefix: "[Doc]"
              labels: ["documentation"]
            - prefix: "[Feature]"
              labels: ["enhancement"]
            - prefix: "[CI]"
              labels: ["ci"]
            # [Misc] 类型缺失
